appraisal_events.evidence: Vous croyez que Chartres est pour Dreyfus ? demanda la duchesse en souriant... l'air scandalisé. / Il aurait préféré un simple soldat, murmura Mme de Guermantes... « Si, Monseigneur, de vos bracelets. »
appraisal_events.explanation: The duchesse again drives the exchange with a mock-scandalized quip and a cutting recycled riposte about the Bulgarian prince, reasserting her command of the room's wit.

appraisal_events.evidence: Vous n'allez pas ce soir au bal de Mme de Sagan ? dit M. de Norpois à Mme de Villeparisis pour couper court à l'entretien avec Bloch.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator states outright that Norpois changes the subject specifically to cut off his exchange with Bloch, deliberately closing him out of the conversation.

status_effects.explanation: Her quips again land, reinforcing her position as the sharpest wit in the exchange.
Norpois deliberately turns away from Bloch to address Mme de Villeparisis, explicitly to end the conversation with him, shutting him out of the exchange.
Norpois retains full control of the conversation, redirecting it at will and closing off Bloch's line of inquiry.
